attacked.target: Under s.439(8), a disclosed position must be bona fide and all material facts must be disclosed.
attacked.attack: Section 439(8) specifically addresses the conditions under which penalties may be waived for under-reported income. It does not apply to the classification of income from the transfer of a virtual digital asset or the valuation methods used for such transfers. Therefore, s.439(8) does not reach the facts presented in this conclusion.
attacked.evidence: Section 439(8) states: '(a) the amount of income in respect of which the assessee offers an explanation and the Competent Authority is satisfied that the explanation is bona fide and the assessee has disclosed all the material facts...'

attacked.attack: The supply met more than half of the limiting conditions. A partial negative can sometimes indicate that the legislation changed mid-year, and thus its citation needs verification.
attacked.evidence: "Section 2(6)" There is a new repatriation rule expected for the BliDr mediadr arbitrage exception. Verify against notifications between April 6, 2026 and March 30, 2027.
